question: Which of the following was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by WHO in 2022?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. WHO declared mpox a PHEIC in July 2022 — only the second active PHEIC after COVID-19 at that time.
Not quite. The Nipah outbreaks in Kerala (2018, 2021, 2023) were national public health emergencies but were not declared PHEICs by WHO.
Dengue causes major regional burden but has not been declared a PHEIC; mpox met the IHR criteria in 2022.
H1N1 was declared a pandemic in 2009; its resurgence post-2020 has not triggered a new PHEIC declaration.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the WHO PHEIC timeline. Mpox was declared the second concurrent PHEIC alongside COVID-19 in mid-2022.
Well done! The 2022 mpox PHEIC exemplifies how novel or re-emerging pathogens can trigger international concern rapidly.
